memories.text: Milo completely knocked out, sleeping peacefully.
Milo spending a little time with his brother Shiloh.
Milo laying down on the ground, just being his goofy little self.

message: Happy 2nd birthday, Milo. You’re my little best friend, and somehow you make every day better just by being around. I’m glad I get to grow up with you. Love you, buddy.
